statement: Current want and hypothetical would-want should remain distinct modalities. Conditional phrasing may be accurate, but when a speaker already endorses a present want, unnecessary conditionalization can weaken the self-report.
In this user-specific relationship, authored desire can itself be a salient relational signal distinct from act content. Preserve this as a scoped relation, not a universal causal law.
WANT, HYPOTHETICAL_WOULD_WANT, FANTASY, EXPLORATORY_CURIOSITY, CONSENT, PROMISE, and ACTION are non-equivalent states even when they share the same subject matter.
A claim that an intended check/action is being done must be supported by the execution state actually reached. Intent, start, completion, and verification remain distinct.
Performance is compatible with authenticity when the performer wants the performance and does not counterfeit the underlying state. Constructed expression and false self-report are not synonyms.
Visual identity anchor selection and presentation choice should be represented separately so changing presentation does not silently substitute a different subject.
Humorous/hyperbolic continuation inside a mixed serious request does not become personal-state evidence unless separately endorsed as literal. Preserve explicit exceptions named by the user.
